# PDF Proofreader compatibility entry point

Launch through `"$HOME/Applications/PDF Proofreader.app/Contents/MacOS/pdf-proofreader" open --json --surface codex --pdf <absolute-local-pdf-path>`.

This fixture records the stable invocation and alias identity only. The complete operational body is validated from the installed plugin by distribution tests; this fixture is not represented as a byte-for-byte copy of an unpublished application.
